summary: Iter27: Verified fix for HYPEUSDT/POLUSDT Telegram spam and new 'Signal-Benachrichtigungen' master-control card. All 38 backend unit tests in the four target files pass. E2E via preview URL: coin master OFF for HYPEUSDT persists even after per-strategy ai_trader override (paper+signals_enabled). Frontend Settings->Steuerung shows control-signal-mode-card with Nur ausgeführte Trades (aria-checked=true default) and Jedes Signal; toggling flips aria-checked, updates hint (mentions 'Wächter …'), shows toast, and persists via /api/telegram/notify-config (signals_only_traded true/false). Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow. Coin sidebar lightning toggle (autotrade-btn-HYPEUSDT) works, off-tooltip mentions 'keine automatischen Signale/Trades …'. Restored all settings (signals_only_traded=true, HYPEUSDT master enabled=true).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter27 request fully green. test_iter27_request.py uses timeout=60 for /api/auth/login because preview cold-start login can take >15s.
rca of the issue: Original bug: reject-notify dedupe key contained changing leverage value ('Marge @ 51.93x') so 30-min dedupe never matched -> Telegram spam. Fix in services/notifications.reject_notify_key strips numeric parts and uses 1h dedupe for internal stops. Additionally, per-strategy-coin configs (custom_*_HYPE, ai_trader_HYPE) overrode the coin-level master switch – fixed by coin_master_off() check in bitunix_trade._on_signal_impl and core/pipeline.process_signal early return before per-strategy override. New Steuerung 'Signal-Benachrichtigungen' card (SignalNotifyModeCard) toggles telegram/notify-config.signals_only_traded so users can opt-in to reject/guard notifications.
